name: UFW Sync
description: Centrally sync a UFW whitelist (fleet IPs + DDNS home exits) to every agent via admin:exec. Phase 1 = read-only probe (no firewall changes).
author: lddcc

help.zh_CN: 设置后可用 GET /exec-test?token=<此值> 手动触发。登录的管理员无需 token。留空则禁用匿名手动触发（仅 cron 与登录管理员可用）。
help.en: When set, GET /exec-test?token=<value> triggers manually. Logged-in admins need no token. Empty disables anonymous manual triggering (cron + logged-in admins only).
